segments.text: Warning: the Mahindra Thar may cause extreme off-roading cravings and spontaneous adventures
This beast is powered by a hearty 2.0-litre engine - because who needs a small heart in a big boy's toy?
With 152 PS of power, you'll have just enough juice to get into (and out of) all sorts of trouble
And when things get really messy, 320 Nm of torque will yank you out of sticky situations

The price? Well, let's just say the LXT RWD Diesel is the ultimate value variant - you get a 10.25-inch infotainment screen, cruise control, keyless entry, and a rear camera, all without breaking the bank or paying for 4x4
Let's face it, if you're buying the Thar for on-road comfort, you're not just doing it wrong - you're doing it tragically wrong
So, where will the Thar take you on your next adventure? Share your wildest off-roading dreams with us and let's get this conversation started! Follow for more
